sentences.zh: 志二十五

translations.literal: Treatise 25
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 25

sentences.zh: 時憲六

translations.literal: Shixian 6
translations.idiomatic: Shixian Calendar 6

sentences.zh: 雍正癸卯元法上

translations.literal: Within the Yongzheng guimao epoch system, upper section
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng guimao calendrical system — upper section

sentences.zh: 日躔日躔改法之原：

translations.literal: Solar motion — principles underlying reforms to the method:
translations.idiomatic: Solar motion — principles underlying the reforms to the method:

sentences.zh: 一，更定歲實以衡消長。

translations.literal: First, re-fix the tropical year length to balance waxing and waning.
translations.idiomatic: First, revise the tropical year length to account for its gradual shortening.

sentences.zh: 歲實古多而今少，故授時有消長之術。

translations.literal: The tropical year was longer in antiquity and shorter now; hence time-reckoning has a waxing-and-waning technique.
translations.idiomatic: The tropical year was longer in antiquity and has grown shorter over time, which is why calendrical systems include a correction for this gradual change.

sentences.zh: 西人第谷所定，減郭守敬萬分之三。

translations.literal: The Western scholar Tycho fixed it by reducing Guo Shoujing's value by three per ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Tycho Brahe set a value three parts in ten thousand below Guo Shoujing's.

sentences.zh: 至奈端等屢加測驗，謂第谷所減太過，定為三百六十五日二四二三三四四二０一四一五，比第谷所定多萬分之一有奇。

translations.literal: When Newton and others repeatedly tested, they said Tycho's reduction was excessive and fixed it at 365 days 24 23 34 42 01 41 5, a little more than one per ten thousand above Tycho's figure.
translations.idiomatic: Newton and his successors, after repeated observation, judged Tycho's reduction excessive and fixed the year at 365.242344201415 days — slightly more than one part in ten thousand above Tycho's value.

sentences.zh: 以除周天三百六十度，得每日平行，比第谷所定少五纖有奇。

translations.literal: Dividing the 360-degree circuit of heaven yields the daily mean motion, a little more than five fibres less than Tycho's figure.
translations.idiomatic: Dividing this into the 360° circuit of heaven yields a daily mean solar motion slightly more than five fibres less than Tycho's.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this value.

sentences.zh: 一，更定黃赤距緯以徵翕闢。

translations.literal: Second, re-fix the ecliptic obliquity to verify contraction and expansion.
translations.idiomatic: Second, revise the obliquity of the ecliptic to track its gradual decrease.

sentences.zh: 黃赤大距，古闊而今狹，恆有減而無增，西人利酌理、噶西尼測定黃赤大距二十三度二十九分，比第谷所定少二分三十秒，比刻白爾所定少一分。

translations.literal: The great distance of yellow and red was wide in antiquity and narrow now, always decreasing never increasing; Western scholars Riccioli and Cassini measured obliquity at 23°29′, two minutes thirty seconds less than Tycho, one minute less than Kepler.
translations.idiomatic: The obliquity of the ecliptic was greater in antiquity and has steadily narrowed; Riccioli and Cassini measured it at 23°29′ — 2′30″ below Tycho and 1′ below Kepler.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this value.

sentences.zh: 一，細考清蒙氣差以祛歧視。

translations.literal: Third, examine closely atmospheric refraction to remove divergent sight.
translations.idiomatic: Third, refine the calculation of atmospheric refraction to eliminate parallax error in observation.

sentences.zh: 西人第谷悟得蒙氣繞地球之周，日月星照蒙氣之外，人在地面為蒙氣所映，必能視之使高。

translations.literal: The Western scholar Tycho understood that misty air circles the earth; sun, moon, and stars shine outside the mist; a person on the ground, reflected by the mist, necessarily sees them raised higher.
translations.idiomatic: Tycho Brahe grasped that the atmosphere encircles the Earth: the luminaries shine beyond it, while an observer on the ground, sighting through the air, necessarily sees them displaced upward.

sentences.zh: 而日月星之光線入蒙氣之中，必反折之使下。

translations.literal: But the light rays of sun, moon, and stars entering within the mist are necessarily refracted downward.
translations.idiomatic: Their light rays, entering the atmosphere, are refracted downward.

sentences.zh: 故光線與視線蒙氣之內合而為一，蒙氣之外，歧而為二。

translations.literal: Hence the light ray and sight line within the mist merge into one; outside the mist they diverge into two.
translations.idiomatic: Within the atmosphere the line of sight and the ray of light coincide; above it they separate into two lines.

sentences.zh: 二線所交，即為蒙氣差角，然未有算術。

translations.literal: Where the two lines meet is the atmospheric-refraction angle, but there was not yet a computational method.
translations.idiomatic: The angle between them is the refraction correction, though Tycho had no formula to compute it.

sentences.zh: 噶西尼反覆精求，謂視線光線所歧雖有不同，相合則有定處。

translations.literal: Cassini, through repeated refinement, said that although the divergence of sight line and light ray differs, where they meet has a fixed place.
translations.idiomatic: Cassini, after painstaking inquiry, showed that however much the sight line and light ray diverge, their point of convergence is fixed.

sentences.zh: 自地心過所合處作線抵圓周，即為蒙氣割線。

translations.literal: Drawing a line from the geocenter through the meeting point to the circumference is the atmospheric refraction secant.
translations.idiomatic: A line from Earth's center through that point to the limb defines the refraction secant.

sentences.zh: 視線與割線成一角，光線與割線亦成一角，二角相減，得蒙氣差角。

translations.literal: The sight line forms an angle with the secant, the light ray also forms an angle with the secant; subtracting the two angles yields the atmospheric-refraction angle.
translations.idiomatic: The angle between the sight line and the secant, minus that between the light ray and the secant, gives the refraction correction.

sentences.zh: 爰在北極出地高四十四度處，屢加精測，得地平上最大差為三十二分一十九秒，蒙氣之厚為地半徑千萬分之六千零九十五，視線角與光線角正弦之比例，常如一千萬與一千萬零二千八百四十一。

translations.literal: Thereupon at a place where the north pole rises forty-four degrees above the horizon, through repeated fine measurement, the maximum difference at the horizon was obtained as 32′19″; atmospheric thickness as 6,095 per ten million of earth radius; the ratio of sines of sight angle and light angle constantly as 10,000,000 to 10,002,841.
translations.idiomatic: At latitude 44°, repeated precision measurements yielded a maximum horizon refraction of 32′19″, an atmospheric thickness of 6,095 parts per ten million of Earth's radius, and a constant sine ratio of 10,000,000 to 10,002,841 between the sight and light angles.

sentences.zh: 用是推得逐度蒙氣差。

translations.literal: Using this, refraction for each degree was derived.
translations.idiomatic: From these constants the refraction at every altitude was derived.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 如圖甲為地心，乙為地面，丙乙為蒙氣之厚，丑甲為割線，癸乙為視線，子戊為光線，癸戊子為蒙氣差角，癸寅、子卯為兩正弦。

translations.literal: As in the diagram: jia is geocenter, yi is ground surface, bing-yi is atmospheric thickness, chou-jia is secant, gui-yi is sight line, zi-wu is light ray, gui-zi-wu is refraction angle, gui-yin and zi-mao are the two sines.
translations.idiomatic: In the diagram: A is Earth's center, B the surface, BC the atmospheric depth, AΩ the secant, BΓ the line of sight, ΓE the ray of light, ΓEΩ the refraction angle, and ΓΞ and EΗ the two sines.

sentences.zh: 一，細考地半徑差以辨蒙雜。

translations.literal: Fourth, examine closely diurnal parallax to distinguish misty confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, refine the diurnal parallax to separate it from refraction.

sentences.zh: 康熙十一年壬子秒分前十四日夜半，火星與太陽沖，西人噶西尼於富郎濟亞國測得火星距天頂五十九度四十分一十五秒，利實爾於同一子午線之噶耶那島測得火星距天頂一十五度四十七分五秒，同時用有千里鏡能測秒微之儀器，與子午線上最近一恆星，測其相距。

translations.literal: Kangxi 11, year renzi, fourteen days before the midnight of the second-fraction, Mars in opposition with the sun; Cassini in France measured Mars's distance from zenith 59°40′15″, Richer on Cayenne Island on the same meridian measured Mars's distance from zenith 15°47′5″; at the same time using instruments with telescopes able to measure seconds and micro-units, with the nearest fixed star on the meridian, measuring their separation.
translations.idiomatic: On the night fourteen days before the Kangxi 11 renzi epoch mark, at Mars's opposition, Cassini in France measured Mars at 59°40′15″ from the zenith while Richer on Cayenne, on the same meridian, found 15°47′5″; both used telescopic instruments precise to the second and measured each planet's distance from the nearest meridian star.

sentences.zh: 噶西尼所得火星較低一十五秒，因恆星無地半徑差以之立法，用平三角形，推得火星在地平上最大地半徑差二十五秒，小餘三七。

translations.literal: Cassini's Mars was lower by fifteen seconds; because fixed stars have no diurnal parallax, establishing law thereby, using plane triangles, Mars's maximum diurnal parallax at the horizon was derived as 25″, remainder 37.
translations.idiomatic: Cassini's Mars appeared 15″ lower; since fixed stars show no parallax, they used plane triangles to derive Mars's maximum horizon parallax as 25.37″.

sentences.zh: 又據歌白尼、第谷測得火星距地與太陽距地之比，如一百與二百六十六，用轉比例法，求得太陽在中距時地平上最大地半徑差一十秒，其逐度之差，以半徑與正弦為比例。

translations.literal: Also according to Copernicus and Tycho's measurement of the ratio of Mars's distance from earth to sun's distance from earth, as 100 to 266, using conversion proportion, the sun's maximum diurnal parallax at horizon at mean distance was obtained as 10″; differences for each degree use radius and sine as proportion.
translations.idiomatic: From Copernicus and Tycho's ratio of Mars's distance to the Sun's (100:266), they derived the Sun's maximum horizon parallax at mean distance as 10″, with degree-by-degree values proportional to radius and sine.

sentences.zh: 本法用之，以求地半徑與日天半徑之比例，中距為一與二萬零六百二十六，最高為一與二萬零九百七十五，最卑為一與二萬零二百七十七，地平上最大地半徑差最高為九秒五十微，最卑為一十秒一十微。

translations.literal: This method uses it to seek the ratio of earth radius to solar celestial radius: at mean distance 1 to 20,626, at apogee 1 to 20,975, at perigee 1 to 20,277; maximum horizon diurnal parallax at apogee 9″50‴, at perigee 10″10‴.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this to fix the ratio of Earth's radius to the Sun's distance: 1:20,626 at mean distance, 1:20,975 at apogee, 1:20,277 at perigee; maximum horizon parallax 9″50‴ at apogee and 10″10‴ at perigee.

sentences.zh: 一，用橢圓面積為平行以酌中數。

translations.literal: Fifth, use elliptical area as mean motion to adjust the middle number.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, use equal areas in the ellipse as mean motion to obtain a balanced value.

sentences.zh: 西人刻白爾以來，屢加精測，盈縮之最大差止一度五十六分一十二秒。

translations.literal: Since the Western scholar Kepler, through repeated fine measurement, the maximum equation-of-center difference is only 1°56′12″.
translations.idiomatic: Since Kepler, repeated precision measurements have fixed the maximum equation of center at 1°56′12″.

sentences.zh: 以推逐度盈縮差，最高前後，本輪失之小，均輪失之大；

translations.literal: To derive degree-by-degree equation differences: near apogee, the deferent errs small, the epicycle errs large;
translations.idiomatic: Degree-by-degree equations of center show that near apogee the deferent model undershoots and the epicycle overshoots;

sentences.zh: 最卑前後，本輪失之大，均輪失之小。

translations.literal: near perigee, the deferent errs large, the epicycle errs small.
translations.idiomatic: near perigee the deferent overshoots and the epicycle undershoots.

sentences.zh: 乃以盈縮最大差折半，檢其正弦，得一六九０００為兩心差。

translations.literal: Then halving the maximum equation difference and checking its sine, 169000 is obtained as the two-center difference.
translations.idiomatic: Halving the maximum equation and taking its sine yields an eccentricity of 169,000.

sentences.zh: 以本天心距最高卑為一千萬，作橢圓，自地心出線，均分其面積，為平行度，以所夾之角為實行度，以推盈縮。

translations.literal: Taking deferent-center distance to apogee and perigee as ten million, constructing an ellipse, lines from geocenter equally dividing its area serve as mean-motion degrees, the angle enclosed as true-motion degrees, to derive equation.
translations.idiomatic: With the deferent radius set at 10,000,000, an ellipse is drawn; lines from Earth's center that bisect equal areas give mean anomaly, and the enclosed angle gives true anomaly, from which the equation is derived.

sentences.zh: 在本輪、均輪所得數之間，而逐度推求，苦無算術。

translations.literal: Falling between deferent and epicycle results, degree-by-degree derivation was painfully without computational method.
translations.idiomatic: The result lies between deferent and epicycle predictions, but no formula existed for degree-by-degree calculation.

sentences.zh: 噶西尼等乃立角積相求諸法，驗諸實測，斯為菂合。

translations.literal: Cassini and others then established methods of mutual angle-area seeking; verified against actual measurement, this fit precisely.
translations.idiomatic: Cassini and his colleagues devised methods relating angle and area that matched observation exactly.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 如圖甲為地心，乙為本天心，丁為最高，丙為最卑，戊己為中距，瓜分之面積為平行，所對之平圓周角度為黃道實行。

translations.literal: As in the diagram: jia is geocenter, yi is deferent center, ding is apogee, bing is perigee, wu-ji is mean distance; divided areas are mean motion, the corresponding mean-circle angle is true ecliptic motion.
translations.idiomatic: In the diagram: A is Earth's center, B the deferent center, D apogee, C perigee, and EF mean distance; equal sectors give mean anomaly and the corresponding angle on the mean circle gives true ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 一，更定最卑行以正引數。

translations.literal: Sixth, re-fix perigee motion to correct the argument.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, revise the perigee motion to correct the anomaly.

sentences.zh: 西人噶西尼等測得每歲平行一分二秒五十九微五十一纖零八忽，比甲子元法多一秒四十九微有奇。

translations.literal: Western scholars Cassini and others measured annual mean motion 1′2″59‴51 fibres 08 hū, a little more than 1″49‴ above the jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: Cassini measured the annual advance of perigee at 1′2″59.51‴08, slightly more than 1″49‴ above the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this value.

sentences.zh: 一，更定平行所在以正歲首。

translations.literal: Seventh, re-fix the position of mean motion to correct the year beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, fix the position of mean motion to establish the correct year beginning.

sentences.zh: 用西人噶西尼所定，推得雍正癸卯年天正冬至為丙申日丑正三刻十一分有奇，比甲子元法遲二刻。

translations.literal: Using Cassini's Western determination, the Yongzheng guimao year first-month winter solstice is derived as day bingshen, chou hour third quarter eleven minutes odd, two quarters later than the jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: From Cassini's constants, the winter solstice of Yongzheng guimao falls on day bingshen at the third quarter of the chou watch — about two quarters later than the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 次日子正初刻最卑過冬至八度七分三十二秒二十二微，比甲子元法多十七分三十五秒四十二微。

translations.literal: The next day at zi hour first quarter, perigee passed winter solstice eight degrees seven minutes thirty-two seconds twenty-two micro-units, seventeen minutes thirty-five seconds forty-two micro-units more than the jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: At the first quarter of the zi watch the following day, perigee had passed the solstice by 8°7′32.22″ — 17′35.42″ more than the jiazi epoch value.

sentences.zh: 月離改法之原：

translations.literal: Lunar motion — principles underlying reforms to the method:
translations.idiomatic: Lunar motion — principles underlying the reforms to the method:

sentences.zh: 一，求太陰本天心距地及最高行，隨時不同，以期通變。

translations.literal: First, seek the moon's deferent-center distance from earth and apogee motion, which differ from time to time, in order to achieve comprehensive adaptation.
translations.idiomatic: First, derive the Moon's varying deferent radius and apogee motion so the method can adapt to every configuration.

sentences.zh: 自西人刻白爾創橢圓之法，奈端等累測月離，得日當月天中距時最大遲疾差為四度五十七分五十七秒，兩心差為四三三一九０。

translations.literal: Since the Western scholar Kepler created the ellipse method, Newton and others cumulatively measured lunar motion; when the sun is at the moon's celestial mean distance, maximum slow-fast difference is 4°57′57″, two-center difference 433190.
translations.idiomatic: Since Kepler introduced elliptical theory, Newton and his successors measured lunar motion repeatedly: when the Sun is at the Moon's mean distance, the maximum equation is 4°57′57″ and the eccentricity 433,190.

sentences.zh: 日當月天最高，或當月天最卑，則最大遲疾差為七度三十九分三十三秒，兩心差為六六七八二０。

translations.literal: When the sun is at the moon's celestial apogee or perigee, the maximum slow-fast difference is 7°39′33″, two-center difference 667820.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sun is at the Moon's apogee or perigee, the maximum equation rises to 7°39′33″ and the eccentricity to 667,820.

sentences.zh: 日曆月天高卑而後，兩心差漸小；

translations.literal: After the sun passes the moon's celestial high and low, the two-center difference gradually diminishes;
translations.idiomatic: After the Sun passes the Moon's apogee or perigee, the eccentricity gradually decreases;

sentences.zh: 中距而後，兩心差漸大；

translations.literal: after mean distance, the two-center difference gradually increases;
translations.idiomatic: after mean distance it gradually increases again;

sentences.zh: 日距月天高卑前後四十五度，兩心差適中。

translations.literal: when the sun is forty-five degrees before and after the moon's celestial high and low, the two-center difference is moderate.
translations.idiomatic: and at 45° on either side of apogee or perigee it reaches a middle value.

sentences.zh: 又日當月天高卑時，最高之行常速，至高卑後四十五度而止；

translations.literal: Moreover when the sun is at the moon's celestial high and low, apogee motion is constantly fast, stopping at forty-five degrees after high and low;
translations.idiomatic: When the Sun is at the Moon's apogee or perigee, apogee motion is always fast until 45° past that point;

sentences.zh: 日當月天中距時，最高之行常遲，至中距後四十五度而止；

translations.literal: when the sun is at the moon's celestial mean distance, apogee motion is constantly slow, stopping at forty-five degrees after mean distance;
translations.idiomatic: when the Sun is at mean distance, apogee motion is always slow until 45° past mean distance;

sentences.zh: 與日月之盈縮遲疾相似，而周轉之數倍之。

translations.literal: similar to the sun and moon's expansion-contraction slow-fast, while the cycle count is doubled.
translations.idiomatic: resembling the solar equation of center but with twice the period.

sentences.zh: 因以地心為心，以兩心差最大最小兩數相加折半，得五五０五０五，為最高本輪半徑。

translations.literal: Therefore taking the geocenter as center, adding the maximum and minimum two-center differences and halving, 550505 is obtained as apogee deferent radius.
translations.idiomatic: Taking Earth's center as origin and averaging the maximum and minimum eccentricities yields 550,505 as the deferent radius of the lunar apogee.

sentences.zh: 相減折半，得一一七三一五，為最高均輪半徑。

translations.literal: Subtracting and halving, 117315 is obtained as apogee epicycle radius.
translations.idiomatic: Half their difference gives 117,315 as the epicycle radius.

sentences.zh: 均輪心循本輪周右旋，行最高平行度；

translations.literal: The epicycle center revolves rightward along the deferent circumference, executing apogee mean-motion degrees;
translations.idiomatic: The epicycle center revolves clockwise on the deferent at the rate of mean apogee motion;

sentences.zh: 本天心循均輪周起最遠點右旋，行日距月天最高之倍度。

translations.literal: the deferent center revolves rightward along the epicycle from the farthest point, executing double the sun's distance from the moon's celestial apogee.
translations.idiomatic: the deferent center revolves clockwise on the epicycle from apogee at twice the Sun's elongation from the lunar apogee.

sentences.zh: 用平三角形，推得最高實均。

translations.literal: Using plane triangles, the true mean apogee is derived.
translations.idiomatic: Plane triangles yield the true mean apogee.

sentences.zh: 又推得逐時兩心差，以求面積。

translations.literal: Also deriving hour-by-hour two-center difference to seek area.
translations.idiomatic: The hourly eccentricity is also derived to compute equal areas.

sentences.zh: 如日躔求盈縮法，以求遲疾，名曰初均。

translations.literal: As the solar-motion method for seeking expansion-contraction, to seek slow-fast, named the first equation.
translations.idiomatic: The solar area method is applied to obtain the equation, called the first inequality.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 如圖戊為地心，甲壬癸子為本輪，乙丁丑丙為均輪，丙丁皆本天心，丙為最遠，丁為最近，戊丙兩心差大，己庚橢圓面積少，戊丁兩心差小，辛申橢圓面積多。

translations.literal: As in the diagram: wu is geocenter, jia-ren-gui-zi are deferent, yi-ding-chou-bing are epicycle, bing and ding are both deferent centers, bing is farthest, ding nearest; wu-bing two-center difference large, ji-geng elliptical area small; wu-ding two-center difference small, xin-shen elliptical area large.
translations.idiomatic: In the diagram: E is Earth's center; the deferent is marked at four points and the epicycle at four; C and D are deferent centers, C farthest and D nearest; a large eccentricity E–C yields a small sector ji–geng, a small eccentricity E–D a large sector xin–shen.

sentences.zh: 一，增立一平均數以合時差。

translations.literal: Second, add a first mean correction to match time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Second, add a first evection term to correct the time equation.

sentences.zh: 西人刻白爾以來，奈端等屢加測驗，得日在最卑後太陰平行常遲，最高平行、正交平行常速。

translations.literal: Since Kepler, Newton and others repeatedly tested: after the sun is at perigee, lunar mean motion is constantly slow; apogee mean and node mean constantly fast.
translations.idiomatic: Since Kepler, Newton and his successors found that after solar perigee the Moon's mean motion is consistently slow, while mean apogee and mean node motions are fast.

sentences.zh: 日在最高後反是。

translations.literal: After the sun is at apogee the reverse holds.
translations.idiomatic: After solar apogee the pattern reverses.

sentences.zh: 因定日在中距，太陰平行差一十一分五十秒，最高平行差一十九分五十六秒，正交平行差九分三十秒。

translations.literal: Therefore fixing when the sun is at mean distance: lunar mean difference 11′50″, apogee mean difference 19′56″, node mean difference 9′30″.
translations.idiomatic: At mean solar distance the corrections are fixed at 11′50″ for mean motion, 19′56″ for mean apogee, and 9′30″ for mean node.

sentences.zh: 其間逐度之差，皆以太陽中距之均數與太陽逐度之均數為比例，名曰一平均。

translations.literal: The degree-by-degree differences between use the sun's mean-distance mean and the sun's degree-by-degree mean as proportion, named the first mean.
translations.idiomatic: Intermediate values are proportional to the solar mean anomaly and its variation, and this term is called the first evection.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 一，增立二平均數以均面積。

translations.literal: Third, add a second mean correction to balance area.
translations.idiomatic: Third, add a second evection term to equalize area.

sentences.zh: 西人奈端以來，屢加精測，得太陽在月天高卑前後太陰平行常遲，至高卑後四十五度而止。

translations.literal: Since Newton, through repeated fine measurement: when the sun is before and after the moon's celestial high and low, lunar mean motion is constantly slow, stopping at forty-five degrees after high and low.
translations.idiomatic: Since Newton, precision measurements show that when the Sun is near the Moon's apogee or perigee, mean motion is consistently slow until 45° past that point.

sentences.zh: 在月天中距前後反是。

translations.literal: Before and after the moon's celestial mean distance the reverse holds.
translations.idiomatic: Near mean distance the pattern reverses.

sentences.zh: 然積遲、積速之多，正在四十五度，而太陽在最高與在最卑，其差又有不同。

translations.literal: Yet the abundance of accumulated slow and fast is exactly at forty-five degrees, while when the sun is at apogee versus perigee the difference again differs.
translations.idiomatic: The greatest cumulative retardation and acceleration occur at 45°, with different magnitudes depending on whether the Sun is at apogee or perigee.

sentences.zh: 因定太陽在最高，距月天高卑中距後四十五度之最大差為三分三十四秒；

translations.literal: Therefore fixing when the sun is at apogee, the maximum difference at forty-five degrees after the moon's celestial high-low mean distance is 3′34″;
translations.idiomatic: At solar apogee the maximum correction 45° past the midpoint between lunar apogee and perigee is 3′34″;

sentences.zh: 太陽在最卑，距月天高卑中距後四十五度之最大差為三分五十六秒。

translations.literal: when the sun is at perigee, the maximum difference at forty-five degrees after the moon's celestial high-low mean distance is 3′56″.
translations.idiomatic: at solar perigee it is 3′56″.

sentences.zh: 高卑後為減，中距後為加，其間日距月最高逐度之差，皆以半徑與日距月最高倍度之正弦為比例。

translations.literal: After high-low is subtractive, after mean distance additive; the degree-by-degree differences of sun's distance from moon's apogee all use radius and sine of double sun's distance from moon's apogee as proportion.
translations.idiomatic: It subtracts after apogee/perigee and adds after mean distance; intermediate values are proportional to the sine of twice the Sun's elongation from lunar apogee.

sentences.zh: 太陽距地逐度之差，又以太陽高卑距地之立方較與太陽本日距地同太陽最高距地之立方較為比例，名曰二平均。

translations.literal: The sun's degree-by-degree distance-from-earth differences further use the cube comparison of sun high-low distance from earth and the cube comparison of the sun's distance from earth that day with the sun's apogee distance from earth as proportion, named the second mean.
translations.idiomatic: Variations with solar distance use the ratio of cubes of the Sun's current and apogee distances, and this term is called the second evection.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 一，增立三平均數以合交差。

translations.literal: Fourth, add a third mean correction to match node difference.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, add a third evection term to correct the node inequality.

sentences.zh: 西人奈端以來，定白極在正交均輪周行日距正交之倍度，因定太陽在黃白兩交後，則太陰平行又稍遲；

translations.literal: Since Newton, fixing the white pole on the node epicycle circumference executing double the sun's distance from node; therefore fixing when the sun is after the yellow-white two nodes, lunar mean motion is again slightly slow;
translations.idiomatic: Since Newton, the lunar pole is set to revolve on the node epicycle at twice the Sun's elongation from the node; when the Sun is past either node, mean motion is slightly slow;

sentences.zh: 在黃白大距後，則太陰平行又稍速；

translations.literal: after the yellow-white greatest distance, lunar mean motion is again slightly fast;
translations.idiomatic: when past quadrature it is slightly fast;

sentences.zh: 其最大差為四十七秒。

translations.literal: its maximum difference is 47″.
translations.idiomatic: with a maximum of 47″.

sentences.zh: 兩交後為減，大距後為加。

translations.literal: After the two nodes is subtractive, after greatest distance additive.
translations.idiomatic: It subtracts after the nodes and adds after quadrature.

sentences.zh: 其逐度之差，皆以半徑與日距正交倍度之正弦為比例，名曰三平均。

translations.literal: Its degree-by-degree differences all use radius and sine of double sun's distance from node as proportion, named the third mean.
translations.idiomatic: Intermediate values are proportional to the sine of twice the Sun's elongation from the node, and this is called the third evection.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 一，更定二均數以正倍離。

translations.literal: Fifth, re-fix the second equation to correct double separation.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, revise the second inequality to correct the variation.

sentences.zh: 西人噶西尼以來，屢加測驗，定日在最高朔望前後四十五度，最大差為三十三分一十四秒；

translations.literal: Since Cassini, through repeated testing: fixing when the sun is at apogee, forty-five degrees before and after new and full moon, maximum difference is 33′14″;
translations.idiomatic: Cassini's observations fix the maximum second inequality at 33′14″ when the Sun is at apogee and 45° from syzygy;

sentences.zh: 日在最卑朔望前後四十五度，最大差為三十七分一十一秒。

translations.literal: when the sun is at perigee, forty-five degrees before and after new and full moon, maximum difference is 37′11″.
translations.idiomatic: and at 37′11″ when the Sun is at perigee under the same conditions.

sentences.zh: 朔望後為加，兩弦後為減。

translations.literal: After new and full moon is additive, after the two quadratures subtractive.
translations.idiomatic: It adds after syzygy and subtracts after quadrature.

sentences.zh: 其間月距日逐度之二均，則以半徑與月距日倍度之正弦為比例。

translations.literal: The degree-by-second-equation differences of moon's distance from sun use radius and sine of double moon's distance from sun as proportion.
translations.idiomatic: Intermediate values are proportional to the sine of twice the Moon's elongation from the Sun.

sentences.zh: 其太陽距最高逐度二均之差，又以日天高卑距地之立方較與本日太陽距地同太陽最高距地之立方較為比例，與二平均同。

translations.literal: The sun's degree-by-second-equation differences from apogee further use the cube comparison of solar celestial high-low distance from earth and the cube comparison of the sun's distance from earth that day with the sun's apogee distance from earth as proportion, same as the second mean.
translations.idiomatic: Variations with solar distance use the same cube-ratio method as the second evection.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 一，更定三均數以合總數。

translations.literal: Sixth, re-fix the third equation to match the total.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, revise the third inequality to reconcile the combined correction.

sentences.zh: 西人噶西尼以來，取月距日與月高距日高共為九十度時測之，除末均之差外，其差與月距日或月高距日高之獨為九十度者等。

translations.literal: Since Cassini, measuring when moon's distance from sun and moon's apogee distance from solar apogee together total ninety degrees: aside from the final-equation difference, the difference equals when moon's distance from sun or moon's apogee distance from solar apogee alone is ninety degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Cassini found that when the sum of the Moon's elongation and the separation of their apogees equals 90°, the correction—aside from the final inequality—equals that when either alone is 90°.

sentences.zh: 又取月距日與月高距日高共為四十五度時測之，亦除末均差外，其差與月距日或月高距日高之獨為四十五度者等。

translations.literal: Also measuring when they together total forty-five degrees: aside from the final-equation difference, the difference equals when either alone is forty-five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The same holds when their sum is 45°.

sentences.zh: 乃定太陰三均之差，在月距日與月高距日高之總度半周內為加，半周外為減。

translations.literal: Then fixing the moon's third-equation difference: within half a circuit of the total of moon's distance from sun and moon's apogee distance from solar apogee is additive, outside half a circuit subtractive.
translations.idiomatic: The third inequality is therefore additive within half a cycle of their combined arc and subtractive beyond it.

sentences.zh: 其九十度與二百七十度之最大差為二分二十五秒。

translations.literal: Its maximum difference at ninety and two hundred seventy degrees is 2′25″.
translations.idiomatic: The maximum at 90° and 270° is 2′25″.

sentences.zh: 其間逐度之差，以半徑與總度之正弦為比例。

translations.literal: The degree-by-degree differences between use radius and sine of total degrees as proportion.
translations.idiomatic: Intermediate values are proportional to the sine of the combined arc.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 一，增立末均數以合距度。

translations.literal: Seventh, add a final-equation correction to match separation degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, add a final inequality term to account for separation in longitude.

sentences.zh: 西人噶西尼以來，測日月最高同度或日月同度兩者只有一相距之差，則止有三均。

translations.literal: Since Cassini, measuring when sun and moon apogees are same degree or sun and moon same degree with only one separation difference, then only three equations apply.
translations.idiomatic: Cassini found that when the solar and lunar apogees coincide, or when the Sun and Moon share the same longitude with only one separation variable, three inequalities suffice.

sentences.zh: 若兩高有距度，日月又有距度，則三均之外，朔後又差而遲，望後又差而速。

translations.literal: If the two apogees have separation and sun and moon also have separation, beyond the three equations, after new moon again differs and is slow, after full moon again differs and is fast.
translations.idiomatic: When both apogees and both bodies are separated in longitude, beyond the three inequalities the Moon is additionally slow after new moon and fast after full moon.

sentences.zh: 及至月高距日高九十度、月距日亦九十度時，無三均，而其差反最大。

translations.literal: When moon's apogee distance from solar apogee is ninety degrees and moon's distance from sun also ninety degrees, there is no third equation, yet the difference is instead greatest.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when lunar apogee is 90° from solar apogee and the Moon is 90° from the Sun, the third inequality vanishes while the correction reaches its maximum.

sentences.zh: 故知三均之外，又有末均。

translations.literal: Therefore knowing beyond the three equations there is also a final equation.
translations.idiomatic: This shows that a fourth term—the final inequality—is needed.

sentences.zh: 乃將月高距日高九十度分為九限，各於月距日九十度時測之，兩高相距九十度，其差三分；

translations.literal: Then dividing moon's apogee distance from solar apogee at ninety degrees into nine limits, each measured when moon's distance from sun is ninety degrees: two apogees separated ninety degrees, difference three minutes;
translations.idiomatic: The arc between apogees at 90° was divided into nine steps and measured when the Moon was also at 90° elongation: at 90° separation the correction is 3′;

sentences.zh: 八十度，其差二分三十九秒；

translations.literal: eighty degrees, difference 2′39″;

sentences.zh: 七十度，其差二分一十九秒；

translations.literal: seventy degrees, difference 2′19″;

sentences.zh: 六十度，其差二分；

translations.literal: sixty degrees, difference 2′;

sentences.zh: 五十度，其差一分四十三秒；

translations.literal: fifty degrees, difference 1′43″;

sentences.zh: 四十度，其差一分二十八秒；

translations.literal: forty degrees, difference 1′28″;

sentences.zh: 三十度，其差一分一十六秒；

translations.literal: thirty degrees, difference 1′16″;

sentences.zh: 二十度，其差一分七秒；

translations.literal: twenty degrees, difference 1′7″;

sentences.zh: 一十度，其差一分一秒。

translations.literal: ten degrees, difference 1′1″.

sentences.zh: 其間逐度之差，用中比例求之。

translations.literal: The degree-by-degree differences between use mean proportion to derive.
translations.idiomatic: Intermediate values are found by linear interpolation.

sentences.zh: 其間月距日逐度之差，皆以半徑與月距日之正弦為比例。

translations.literal: The moon's degree-by-degree distance-from-sun differences all use radius and sine of moon's distance from sun as proportion.
translations.idiomatic: Variations with lunar elongation are proportional to the sine of that elongation.

sentences.zh: 朔後為減，望後為加。

translations.literal: After new moon subtractive, after full moon additive.
translations.idiomatic: It subtracts after new moon and adds after full moon.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 一，更定交均及黃白大距以合差分。

translations.literal: Eighth, re-fix node equation and yellow-white greatest distance to match difference divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, revise the node inequality and the maximum lunar latitude to reconcile the corrections.

sentences.zh: 西人奈端、噶西尼以來，測得日在兩交時，交角最大為五度一十七分二十秒；

translations.literal: Since Newton and Cassini, measured when the sun is at the two nodes, node angle maximum is 5°17′20″;
translations.idiomatic: Newton and Cassini measured the maximum node angle at 5°17′20″ when the Sun is at the nodes;

sentences.zh: 日距交九十度時，交角最小為四度五十九分三十五秒。

translations.literal: when sun's distance from node is ninety degrees, node angle minimum is 4°59′35″.
translations.idiomatic: and the minimum at 4°59′35″ when the Sun is 90° from the node.

sentences.zh: 朔望而後，交角又有加分。

translations.literal: After new and full moon, node angle again has an added portion.
translations.idiomatic: After syzygy the node angle receives an additional increment.

sentences.zh: 因日距交與月距日之漸遠，以漸而大，至日距交九十度、月距日亦九十度時，加二分四十三秒。

translations.literal: Because sun's distance from node and moon's distance from sun gradually increase, gradually growing larger, until sun's distance from node ninety degrees and moon's distance from sun also ninety degrees, add 2′43″.
translations.idiomatic: This increment grows as the Sun moves from the node and the Moon from the Sun, reaching 2′43″ when both are at 90°.

sentences.zh: 交均之最大者，為一度二十九分四十二秒。

translations.literal: The maximum of the node equation is 1°29′42″.
translations.idiomatic: The maximum node inequality is 1°29′42″.

sentences.zh: 乃以最大、最小兩交角相加折半，為繞黃極本輪；

translations.literal: Then adding maximum and minimum node angles and halving, this is the deferent circling the ecliptic pole;
translations.idiomatic: Averaging the maximum and minimum node angles gives the deferent around the ecliptic pole;

sentences.zh: 相減折半，為負白極均輪。

translations.literal: subtracting and halving, this is the counter-rotating lunar-pole epicycle.
translations.idiomatic: half their difference gives the counter-rotating epicycle of the lunar pole.

sentences.zh: 分均輪全徑為五，取其一，內去朔望後加分，為最大加分小輪全徑，設於白道，餘為交均小輪全徑。

translations.literal: Dividing epicycle full diameter into five, taking one, subtracting within the post-syzygy added portion, as maximum added-portion minor wheel full diameter set on the white path; remainder is node-equation minor wheel full diameter.
translations.idiomatic: One-fifth of the epicycle diameter, minus the syzygy increment, forms the syzygy correction wheel on the lunar path; the remainder forms the node-inequality wheel.

sentences.zh: 與均輪全徑相減，餘為負小輪全徑，與均輪同心，均輪負而行，不自行。

translations.literal: Subtracting from epicycle full diameter, remainder is counter minor wheel full diameter, concentric with epicycle; epicycle moves by counter-rotation, not by self-motion.
translations.idiomatic: The difference is the counter-wheel diameter, concentric with the epicycle, which is driven by counter-rotation rather than rotating on its own.

sentences.zh: 均輪心行於本輪周，左旋，為正交平行。

translations.literal: Epicycle center moves on deferent circumference, leftward rotation, as true-node mean motion.
translations.idiomatic: The epicycle center revolves counterclockwise on the deferent at mean node motion.

sentences.zh: 交均小輪心在負小輪周，起最遠點，右旋，行日距正交之倍度。

translations.literal: Node-equation minor wheel center on counter minor wheel circumference, starting farthest point, rightward rotation, executing double sun's distance from true node.
translations.idiomatic: The node wheel center moves clockwise on the counter-wheel from apogee at twice the Sun's elongation from the node.

sentences.zh: 白極在交均小輪周，起最遠點，左旋，行度又倍之。

translations.literal: Lunar pole on node-equation minor wheel circumference, starting farthest point, leftward rotation, motion again doubled.
translations.idiomatic: The lunar pole moves counterclockwise on the node wheel at double that rate.

sentences.zh: 而白道上之加分小輪，其周最近。

translations.literal: The added-portion minor wheel on the white path has its circumference nearest.
translations.idiomatic: The syzygy correction wheel lies closest to the lunar path.

sentences.zh: 黃道之點，與朔望之白道相切，其全徑按日距正交倍度為大小，常與最大加分小輪內所當之正矢等。

translations.literal: The ecliptic point tangent to new-full moon white path: its full diameter large or small according to double sun's distance from true node, constantly equal to the versed sine within the maximum added-portion minor wheel.
translations.idiomatic: Where the ecliptic touches the syzygy lunar path, the wheel's diameter varies with twice the Sun's node elongation and always equals the versed sine of the maximum syzygy correction.

sentences.zh: 又按本時全徑內取月距日倍度所當之正矢為所張之度，驗諸實測，無不菂合。

translations.literal: Also within the full diameter at this time taking the versed sine corresponding to double moon's distance from sun as the degree spanned; verified against actual measurement, all fit precisely.
translations.idiomatic: The arc subtended at each moment is taken from the versed sine of twice the lunar elongation; observation confirms every case.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts this procedure.

sentences.zh: 如圖甲為黃極，乙為本輪，丙為均輪，丁為負小輪，戊己皆為交均小輪，庚辛皆為白極，壬為黃道，丑、癸皆為朔望時白道，寅、子皆為兩弦時白道，卯、辰皆為白道上加分小輪。

translations.literal: As in the diagram: jia is ecliptic pole, yi deferent, bing epicycle, ding counter minor wheel, wu and ji both node-equation minor wheels, geng and xin both lunar poles, ren ecliptic, chou and gui both syzygy white paths, yin and zi both quadrature white paths, mao and chen both added-portion minor wheels on white path.
translations.idiomatic: In the diagram: A is the ecliptic pole, B the deferent, C the epicycle, D the counter-wheel, E and F the node wheels, G and H the lunar poles, I the ecliptic, Ω and Γ the syzygy lunar paths, Ξ and Ζ the quadrature paths, and M and N the syzygy correction wheels.

sentences.zh: 一，更定地半徑差以合高均。

translations.literal: Ninth, re-fix diurnal parallax to match apogee equation.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, revise lunar parallax to match the apogee inequality.

sentences.zh: 求得兩心差最大時，最高距地心一０六六七八二０，為六十三倍地半徑又百分之七十七；

translations.literal: When two-center difference is maximum, apogee distance from geocenter 10667820, as sixty-three times earth radius plus seventy-seven hundredths percent;
translations.idiomatic: At maximum eccentricity, apogee distance is 10,667,820 units — 63.77 Earth radii;

sentences.zh: 最卑距地心九三三二一八０，為五十五倍地半徑又百分之七十九。

translations.literal: perigee distance from geocenter 9332180, as fifty-five times earth radius plus seventy-nine hundredths percent.
translations.idiomatic: perigee distance is 9,332,180 — 55.79 Earth radii.

sentences.zh: 兩心差最小時，最高距地心一０四三三一九０，為六十二倍地半徑又百分之三十七；

translations.literal: When two-center difference is minimum, apogee distance from geocenter 10433190, as sixty-two times earth radius plus thirty-seven hundredths percent;
translations.idiomatic: At minimum eccentricity, apogee distance is 10,433,190 — 62.37 Earth radii;

sentences.zh: 最卑距地心九五六六八一０，為五十七倍地半徑又百分之一十九；

translations.literal: perigee distance from geocenter 9566810, as fifty-seven times earth radius plus nineteen hundredths percent;
translations.idiomatic: perigee distance is 9,566,810 — 57.19 Earth radii;

sentences.zh: 中距距地心一千萬，為五十九倍地半徑又百分之七十八。

translations.literal: mean distance from geocenter ten million, as fifty-nine times earth radius plus seventy-eight hundredths percent.
translations.idiomatic: mean distance is 10,000,000 — 59.78 Earth radii.

sentences.zh: 又用平三角形，求得太陰自高至卑逐度距地心線及地平上最大差。

translations.literal: Also using plane triangles, deriving the moon's degree-by-degree line from apogee to perigee distance from geocenter and maximum difference at horizon.
translations.idiomatic: Plane triangles also yield the Moon's distance from Earth at each orbital position and the maximum horizon parallax.

sentences.zh: 其實高逐度之差，皆以半徑與正弦為比例。

translations.literal: Its true-altitude degree-by-degree differences all use radius and sine as proportion.
translations.idiomatic: Degree-by-degree true altitude varies proportionally to radius and sine.

sentences.zh: 一，更定三種平行及平行所在。

translations.literal: Tenth, re-fix the three mean motions and their positions.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth, fix the three mean motions and their initial positions.

sentences.zh: 太陰每日平行，比甲子元法多千萬分秒之二萬二千三百一十六，最高每日平行，比甲子元法少百萬分秒之七千二百五十一，正交每日平行，比甲子元法少十萬分秒之一百三十七。

translations.literal: Moon daily mean motion exceeds jiazi epoch by 22,316 per ten million minutes-seconds; apogee daily mean motion is less by 7,251 per million; true-node daily mean motion is less by 137 per hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Daily mean lunar motion exceeds the jiazi epoch by 22,316 parts per ten million; mean apogee motion is 7,251 parts per million less; mean node motion is 137 parts per hundred thousand less.

sentences.zh: 雍正癸卯天正冬至，次日子正，太陰平行所在，比甲子元法多二分一十四秒五十七微，最高平行所在，比甲子元法少三十六分三十七秒一十微，正交平行所在，比甲子元法多五分六秒三十三微。

translations.literal: Yongzheng guimao first-month winter solstice, next day zi hour: lunar mean position exceeds jiazi epoch by 2′14″57‴; apogee mean position is less by 36′37″10‴; true-node mean position exceeds by 5′6″33‴.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter solstice of Yongzheng guimao, the following zi hour: mean lunar longitude is 2′14″57‴ ahead of the jiazi epoch, mean apogee 36′37″10‴ behind, and mean node 5′6″33‴ ahead.

sentences.zh: 交食改法之原：

translations.literal: Eclipses — principles underlying reforms to the method:
translations.idiomatic: Eclipses — principles underlying the reforms to the method:

sentences.zh: 一，用兩時日躔、月離黃道度求實朔、望。

translations.literal: First, use two times' solar and lunar ecliptic degrees to seek true new and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: First, determine true syzygy from solar and lunar ecliptic longitudes at two instants.

sentences.zh: 先推平朔、望以求其入交之月，次推本日、次日兩子正之日躔、月離黃道經度以求其實朔、望之時，又推本時次時兩日躔、月離以比例其時刻。

translations.literal: First derive mean new and full moon to find the month entering eclipse; next derive this day and next day at two zi hours' solar and lunar ecliptic longitudes to find true new-full moon time; again derive present and next time's solar and lunar motions to proportion the moment.
translations.idiomatic: Compute mean syzygy to identify the eclipse month, then the Sun and Moon's ecliptic longitudes at zi hour on the current and following day to fix the true syzygy, and interpolate between adjacent hours for the exact moment.

sentences.zh: 與甲子元法止用兩日及用黃白同經者不同。

translations.literal: Different from the jiazi epoch method using only two days and using yellow-white same longitude.
translations.idiomatic: This differs from the jiazi epoch method, which used only two days and assumed equal ecliptic and lunar longitude.

sentences.zh: 一，用兩經斜距求日、月食甚時刻及兩心實相距。

translations.literal: Second, use two longitudes' oblique separation to seek solar-lunar eclipse greatest moment and true center-to-center distance.
translations.idiomatic: Second, use the oblique separation of the two longitudes to find greatest eclipse and the true geocentric distance.

sentences.zh: 以黃白二道原非平行，而日、月兩經常相斜距。

translations.literal: Because the yellow and white two paths are originally not parallel, sun and moon two longitudes are constantly obliquely separated.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic and lunar path are not parallel, so the Sun and Moon are usually separated in latitude as well as longitude.

sentences.zh: 若以太陽為不動，則太陰如由斜距線行，故求兩心相距最近之線，不與白道成正角，而與斜距線成正角。

translations.literal: If taking the sun as unmoving, the moon as if moving along the oblique-separation line; therefore seeking the line of nearest center-to-center approach, it is not perpendicular to the white path but perpendicular to the oblique-separation line.
translations.idiomatic: If the Sun is held fixed, the Moon appears to move along the oblique-separation line; the line of closest approach is therefore perpendicular to that line, not to the lunar path.

sentences.zh: 其距弧變時，亦不以月距日實行度為比例，而以斜距度為比例。

translations.literal: When its separation arc changes, it also does not use moon's distance from sun true-motion degrees as proportion but oblique-separation degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Changes in separation arc are proportional to oblique separation, not to the Moon's true elongation.

sentences.zh: 如圖甲乙為黃道，戊乙為白道，甲戊為實朔、望距緯，甲癸為太陽一小時實行，戊丑為太陰一小時實行。

translations.literal: As in the diagram: jia-yi is ecliptic, wu-yi is white path, jia-wu is true syzygy latitude separation, jia-gui is sun one hour true motion, wu-chou is moon one hour true motion.
translations.idiomatic: In the diagram: AB is the ecliptic, EF the lunar path, AE the latitude separation at syzygy, AΓ the Sun's hourly motion, and EΩ the Moon's.

sentences.zh: 設太陽不動而合癸與甲，則太陰不在丑而在寅。

translations.literal: Setting the sun unmoving and combining gui with jia, the moon is not at chou but at yin.
translations.idiomatic: If the Sun is held at A and Γ combined with A, the Moon lies at Ξ rather than Ω.

sentences.zh: 戊寅為一小時兩經斜距線，甲卯與戊寅成正角，即為兩心相距最近之線，戊卯為食甚距弧，皆借弧線為直線，用平三角形求之。

translations.literal: Wu-yin is one hour's two-longitude oblique-separation line; jia-mao and wu-yin form right angle, namely the line of nearest center approach; wu-mao is greatest-eclipse separation arc; all treat arcs as straight lines, using plane triangles.
translations.idiomatic: EΞ is the hourly oblique-separation line; AM perpendicular to EΞ is the line of closest approach and EM the arc at greatest eclipse—all computed by plane triangles treating arcs as straight lines.

sentences.zh: 初虧、復圓，則以並徑為弦作勾股。

translations.literal: First contact and last contact use combined diameter as chord to form right triangle.
translations.idiomatic: First and last contact are found by right triangles with the combined diameter as chord.

sentences.zh: 一，更定日、月實徑與地徑之比例。

translations.literal: Third, re-fix sun and moon true diameter to earth diameter ratio.
translations.idiomatic: Third, fix the ratios of the true solar and lunar diameters to Earth's diameter.

sentences.zh: 西人默爵製造鏡儀，測得日視徑最高為三十一分四十秒，中距為三十二分一十二秒，最卑為三十二分四十五秒；

translations.literal: Western scholar Maraldi manufactured mirror instrument, measuring sun apparent diameter at apogee 31′40″, at mean distance 32′12″, at perigee 32′45″;
translations.idiomatic: Maraldi, using a reflecting telescope, measured the Sun's apparent diameter at 31′40″ at apogee, 32′12″ at mean distance, and 32′45″ at perigee;

sentences.zh: 月視徑最高為二十九分二十三秒，中距為三十一分二十一秒，最卑為三十三分三十六秒。

translations.literal: moon apparent diameter at apogee 29′23″, at mean distance 31′21″, at perigee 33′36″.
translations.idiomatic: and the Moon's at 29′23″, 31′21″, and 33′36″ respectively.

sentences.zh: 用此數推算日實徑為地徑之九十六倍又十分之六，月實徑為地徑百分之二十七，小餘二六強，太陽光分一十五秒。

translations.literal: Using these numbers to calculate: sun true diameter is 96.6 times earth diameter; moon true diameter is 27.26+ percent of earth diameter; solar light-time 15 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: These yield a true solar diameter of 96.6 Earth diameters, a lunar diameter of 0.2726+ Earth diameters, and a solar light-time of 15 seconds.

sentences.zh: 本法用之。

translations.literal: This method uses it.
translations.idiomatic: The present method adopts these values.

sentences.zh: 一，更定求影半徑法及影差。

translations.literal: Fourth, re-fix the method for shadow radius and shadow difference.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, revise the calculation of the umbral radius and penumbral enlargement.

sentences.zh: 以日、月兩地半徑差相加，內減去日半徑，餘即為實影半徑。

translations.literal: Adding sun and moon two diurnal-parallax differences, subtracting within the sun radius, remainder is true shadow radius.
translations.idiomatic: Adding the solar and lunar parallax angles and subtracting the solar semidiameter gives the true umbral radius.

sentences.zh: 又月食時日在地下，蒙氣轉蔽日光，地影視徑大於實徑約為太陰地半徑差六十九分之一，是為影差。

translations.literal: Moreover at lunar eclipse the sun is below earth; misty air further shields sunlight; earth shadow apparent diameter exceeds true diameter by about one sixty-ninth of lunar diurnal parallax, this is shadow difference.
translations.idiomatic: During lunar eclipse the Sun is below the horizon and atmospheric absorption enlarges the shadow by about one sixty-ninth of the lunar parallax—this is the penumbral correction.

sentences.zh: 如圖甲丁辛三角形，丁辛二內角與壬甲辛一外角等，丁角即太陽地半徑差，辛角即太陰地半徑差，甲丁線略與甲丙日天半徑等，甲辛線略與甲己月天半徑等，其角皆與地半徑甲乙相當故。

translations.literal: As in diagram triangle jia-ding-xin: ding and xin two interior angles equal ren-jia-xin one exterior angle; ding angle is solar diurnal parallax, xin angle lunar diurnal parallax; jia-ding line approximates jia-bing solar celestial radius, jia-xin line approximates jia-ji lunar celestial radius; their angles all correspond to earth radius jia-yi.
translations.idiomatic: In triangle ADE, angles at D and E equal the exterior angle at A; D is solar parallax, E lunar parallax; AD approximates the solar distance and AE the lunar, each angle matching Earth's radius AB.

sentences.zh: 壬甲己對角丙甲丁即日半徑。

translations.literal: Ren-jia-ji opposite angle bing-jia-ding is sun radius.
translations.idiomatic: The angle opposite A at C–A–D is the solar semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 故以丁角、辛角相加，即得壬甲辛角，內減壬甲己角，餘己甲辛角，即實影半徑。

translations.literal: Therefore adding ding and xin angles gives ren-jia-xin angle; subtracting within ren-jia-ji angle, remainder ji-jia-xin angle is true shadow radius.
translations.idiomatic: Adding D and E gives angle AEX; subtracting angle AIC leaves angle IEX as the true umbral radius.

sentences.zh: 一，更定求日食食甚真時及兩心視相距。

translations.literal: Fifth, re-fix seeking solar eclipse greatest true time and apparent center-to-center distance.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, revise the calculation of true greatest eclipse and apparent geocentric separation.

sentences.zh: 借弧線為直線，用平三角形，以食甚用時兩心實相距為一邊，用時高下差為一邊，用時白經高弧交角為所夾之角，求得對角之邊，為兩心視相距，並求得對兩心實相距角。

translations.literal: Treating arcs as straight lines, using plane triangles: taking greatest-eclipse use-time true center distance as one side, use-time altitude difference as one side, use-time white-longitude altitude arc intersection angle as enclosed angle, deriving opposite side as apparent center distance, also deriving angle opposite true center distance.
translations.idiomatic: Treating arcs as straight lines, a plane triangle with true geocentric distance, altitude difference, and lunar latitude angle at the trial instant yields the apparent separation and its opposite angle.

sentences.zh: 復設一時，限西向後設，限東向前設。

translations.literal: Again set one time: westward limit set afterward, eastward limit set beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: A second trial instant is set later for western limits and earlier for eastern limits.

sentences.zh: 求其兩心實相距及高下差為二邊。

translations.literal: Seek its true center distance and altitude difference as two sides.
translations.idiomatic: Its true distance and altitude difference form the two sides.

sentences.zh: 白經高弧交角與對設時距弧角相減，餘為所夾之角，求得對角之邊，為設時兩心視相距，亦求得對兩心實相距角。

translations.literal: White-longitude altitude arc intersection angle minus opposite-set-time separation arc angle, remainder as enclosed angle; deriving opposite side as set-time apparent center distance, also deriving angle opposite true center distance.
translations.idiomatic: The lunar latitude angle minus the arc between trial instants gives the enclosed angle, from which the apparent separation and opposite angle are found.

sentences.zh: 乃取用時、設時兩白經高弧交角較，與用時對兩心實相距角相減。

translations.literal: Then taking use-time and set-time two white-longitude altitude arc intersection angle comparison, subtracting from use-time angle opposite true center distance.
translations.idiomatic: The difference between the two lunar latitude angles is subtracted from the angle opposite the true distance at the first trial.

sentences.zh: 又加設時對兩心實相距角，又與全周相減為一角，用時、設時兩視相距為夾角之二邊，求其對邊為視行，求其中垂線至視行之點，為食甚真時所在，垂線為真時視相距。

translations.literal: Also adding set-time angle opposite true center distance, also subtracting from full circuit as one angle; use-time and set-time two apparent distances as the two sides of enclosed angle, seeking opposite side as apparent motion, seeking perpendicular bisector point to apparent-motion line as greatest-eclipse true time location, perpendicular as true-time apparent distance.
translations.idiomatic: Adding the second opposite angle and forming a triangle with the two apparent separations yields the apparent motion; the perpendicular bisector to this line marks true greatest eclipse and gives the true apparent separation.

sentences.zh: 以上加減，據向後設而言。

translations.literal: The above additions and subtractions are stated for westward-later setting.
translations.idiomatic: These additions and subtractions apply when the second trial is set later.

sentences.zh: 然後以所得真時，復考其兩心視相距果與所求垂線合，即為定真時。

translations.literal: Then using the obtained true time, again verify whether apparent center distance truly matches the sought perpendicular—then it is fixed true time.
translations.idiomatic: The true instant is confirmed when the apparent separation matches the perpendicular distance.

sentences.zh: 如圖乾為日心，乾子為用時兩心實相距，乾壬為高下差，壬子為兩心視相距，乾午為設時兩心實相距，乾己為高下差，己午同壬未為兩心視相距，壬丑中垂線為真時視相距。

translations.literal: As in diagram: qian is heliocenter, qian-zi is use-time true center distance, qian-ren altitude difference, ren-zi apparent center distance, qian-wu set-time true center distance, qian-ji altitude difference, ji-wu same as ren-wei apparent center distance, ren-chou perpendicular bisector is true-time apparent distance.
translations.idiomatic: In the diagram: S is the Sun's center, SΩ the true distance at the first trial, SΝ the parallax, NΩ the apparent distance; SΗ and SΘ the corresponding values at the second trial; and NΧ the perpendicular giving true greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 初虧、復圓法同，但以並徑為比考真時之限。

translations.literal: First contact and last contact method is the same, but using combined diameter as ratio to examine true-time limits.
translations.idiomatic: First and last contact use the same method, with combined diameter defining the limits around true greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 至帶食則以地平為斷，亦逕求兩心視相距，不用視行。

translations.literal: For partial eclipse at horizon, use horizon as boundary; also directly seek apparent center distance without using apparent motion.
translations.idiomatic: For horizon eclipses the horizon sets the limit and apparent separation is found directly without the apparent-motion step.

sentences.zh: 恆星改法之原，見天文志。

translations.literal: Fixed stars — principles of method reform, see Astronomy Treatise.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed stars — principles of reform, see the Astronomy Treatise.

sentences.zh: 土星改法之原，見推步因革篇。

translations.literal: Saturn — principles of method reform, see the chapter on computational evolution.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn — principles of reform, see the chapter on calendrical evolution.

sentences.zh: 羅㬋、計都更名，乾隆五年，和碩庄親王等援古法奏請更正，下大學士、九卿議奏，乾隆九年更正。

translations.literal: Rahu and Ketu renamed: Qianlong 5, Prince Zhuang and others citing ancient method memorialized correction; referred to Grand Secretaries and Nine Ministers for deliberation; corrected Qianlong 9.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 5, Prince Zhuang and others petitioned to restore ancient names for Rahu and Ketu; the Grand Secretariat and Nine Ministers deliberated, and the change took effect in Qianlong 9.

sentences.zh: 紫氣增設之原，大學士、伯訥爾泰等議覆，更定羅㬋、計都名目，并援古法增入紫氣，約二十八年十閏而氣行一周天，每日行二分六秒，小餘七二０七七七。

translations.literal: Purple Qi addition origin: Grand Secretary Bo'ertai and others deliberated reply, re-fixing Rahu-Ketu names and citing ancient method to add Purple Qi; about twenty-eight years ten intercalations for qi to circuit heaven, daily motion 2′6″, remainder 720777.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Bo'ertai's memorial also restored Rahu and Ketu and added Purple Qi (Ziqi) by ancient precedent: it completes a circuit in about 28 years with ten intercalations, moving 2′6″ daily with remainder 720777.

sentences.zh: 以乾隆九年甲子天正冬至，次日子正在七宮十七度五十分十四秒五十三微為元。

translations.literal: Taking Qianlong 9 jiazi first-month winter solstice, next day zi hour at seventh mansion seventeen degrees fifty minutes fourteen seconds fifty-three micro-units as epoch.
translations.idiomatic: Its epoch is the zi hour after the winter solstice of Qianlong 9 jiazi, at 7th mansion 17°50′14.53″.

sentences.zh: 日躔用數，雍正元年癸卯天正冬至為法元。

translations.literal: Solar motion constants: Yongzheng 1 guimao first-month winter solstice as method epoch.
translations.idiomatic: Constants for solar motion — epoch: winter solstice of Yongzheng 1 guimao.

sentences.zh: 壬寅年十一月冬至。

translations.literal: Renyin year, eleventh month, winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Winter solstice of the eleventh month, renyin year.

sentences.zh: 周歲三百六十五日二四二三三四四二。

translations.literal: Circuit year 365 days 24 23 34 42.
translations.idiomatic: Tropical year: 365.2423442 days.

sentences.zh: 太陽每日平行三千五百四十八秒，小餘三二九０八九七。

translations.literal: Sun daily mean motion 3548 seconds, remainder 3290897.
translations.idiomatic: Daily mean solar motion: 3548″, remainder 3290897.

sentences.zh: 最卑歲行六十二秒，小餘九九七五。

translations.literal: Perigee annual motion 62 seconds, remainder 9975.
translations.idiomatic: Annual perigee motion: 62″, remainder 9975.

sentences.zh: 最卑日行十分秒之一又七二四八。

translations.literal: Perigee daily motion one ten-thousandth of a minute-second plus 7248.
translations.idiomatic: Daily perigee motion: 0.0001′ plus 7248.

sentences.zh: 本天橢圓大半徑一千萬，小半徑九百九十九萬八千五百七十一，小餘八五，兩心差十六萬九千。

translations.literal: Deferent ellipse major semiaxis ten million, minor semiaxis 9,998,571.85, two-center difference 169,000.
translations.idiomatic: Deferent ellipse: major semiaxis 10,000,000, minor 9,998,571.85, eccentricity 169,000.

sentences.zh: 宿度，乾隆十八年以前，用康熙壬子年表，十九年以後，用乾隆甲子年表，俱見天文志。

translations.literal: Lodging degrees: before Qianlong 18 use Kangxi renzi star table, after year 19 use Qianlong jiazi star table; all see Astronomy Treatise.
translations.idiomatic: Lodging degrees before Qianlong 18 follow the Kangxi renzi table; from year 19 onward the Qianlong jiazi table — both in the Astronomy Treatise.

sentences.zh: 各省及蒙古、回部、兩金川土司北極高度、東西偏度，見天文志。

translations.literal: Each province and Mongolia, Muslim regions, two Jinchuan chieftaincies' north pole altitude and east-west deviation, see Astronomy Treatise.
translations.idiomatic: North polar altitudes and longitudes for provinces, Mongolia, Muslim regions, and the Jinchuan chieftaincies are in the Astronomy Treatise.

sentences.zh: 黃赤大距二十三度二十九分。

translations.literal: Yellow-red great distance twenty-three degrees twenty-nine minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Obliquity of the ecliptic: 23°29′.

sentences.zh: 最卑應八度七分三十二秒二十二微。

translations.literal: Perigee response eight degrees seven minutes thirty-two seconds twenty-two micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Perigee anomaly: 8°7′32.22″.

sentences.zh: 氣應三十二日一二二五四。

translations.literal: Qi response thirty-two days 12254.
translations.idiomatic: Ziqi epoch offset: 32 days 12254.

sentences.zh: 宿應二十七日一二二五四。

translations.literal: Lodging response twenty-seven days 12254.
translations.idiomatic: Lodging epoch offset: 27 days 12254.

sentences.zh: 宿名，乾隆十八年以前，同甲子元，十九年以後，易觜前參後，餘見甲子元法。

translations.literal: Lodging names: before Qianlong 18 same as jiazi epoch; after year 19, exchange Zi before Shen after; remainder see jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: Lodging names before Qianlong 18 follow the jiazi epoch; from year 19 onward Zi and Shen are swapped — see the jiazi epoch method for the rest.

sentences.zh: 推日躔法求天正冬至，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Solar-motion method to seek first-month winter solstice, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice of the first month, use the same method as the jiazi epoch.

sentences.zh: 求平行，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Seek mean motion, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: Mean motion is computed as in the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 求實行，先求引數，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Seek true motion: first seek anomaly, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: True motion: first compute the anomaly as in the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 乃用平三角形，以二千萬為一邊，倍兩心差為一邊，引數為所夾之角，六宮內用內角，六宮外與全周相減用其餘。

translations.literal: Then using plane triangle: twenty million as one side, double two-center difference as one side, anomaly as enclosed angle; within six mansions use interior angle, outside six mansions subtract from full circuit and use remainder.
translations.idiomatic: A plane triangle uses 20,000,000 and twice the eccentricity as sides and the anomaly as angle — the interior angle within six mansions, otherwise the supplement to 360°.

sentences.zh: 求得對倍兩心差之角，倍之為橢圓界角。

translations.literal: Obtain angle opposite double two-center difference, double it as ellipse boundary angle.
translations.idiomatic: Double the angle opposite twice the eccentricity to obtain the ellipse boundary angle.

sentences.zh: 又以本天小半徑為一率，大半徑為二率，前所夾角正切為三率，求得四率為橢圓之正切，檢表得度分秒。

translations.literal: Also taking deferent minor semiaxis as first ratio, major semiaxis as second ratio, preceding enclosed angle tangent as third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as ellipse tangent, table lookup for degrees minutes seconds.
translations.idiomatic: A proportion with minor semiaxis, major semiaxis, and the tangent of the enclosed angle yields the ellipse tangent, converted to degrees from tables.

sentences.zh: 與引數相減，餘為橢圓差角。

translations.literal: Subtract from anomaly, remainder is ellipse difference angle.
translations.idiomatic: Subtracting from the anomaly gives the ellipse difference angle.

sentences.zh: 最卑前後各三宮與橢圓界角相加，最高前後各三宮與橢圓界角相減，自初宮為最卑後，以此順計。

translations.literal: Three mansions before and after perigee add ellipse boundary angle; three mansions before and after apogee subtract it; from first mansion as after perigee, count forward accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Add the boundary angle for three mansions on either side of perigee and subtract it near apogee, counting forward from the first mansion after perigee.

sentences.zh: 為均數。

translations.literal: This is the equation.
translations.idiomatic: This is the equation of center.

sentences.zh: 置平行，以均數加減之，引數初宮至五宮為加，六宮至十一宮為減。

translations.literal: Set mean motion, add or subtract equation; anomaly first mansion to fifth mansion is add, sixth to eleventh is subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the equation to mean motion — add from mansions 1–5 and subtract from mansions 6–11.

sentences.zh: 得實行。

sentences.zh: 求正交平行，同甲子元法。
