translations.idiomatic: Mean node motion is computed as in the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 求初實行，用平三角形，以最高本輪半徑為一邊，最高均輪半徑為一邊，日距月最高倍度與半周相減，餘為所夾之角，求得對均輪半徑之角，為最高實均，記加減號。

translations.literal: Seek first true motion: using plane triangle, apogee deferent radius as one side, apogee epicycle radius as one side, double sun distance from moon apogee minus half circuit as enclosed angle; obtain angle opposite epicycle radius as apogee true mean, record add-subtract sign.
translations.idiomatic: First true motion: a plane triangle with deferent and epicycle radii and the supplement of twice the Sun's elongation from lunar apogee yields the true mean apogee, with sign recorded.

sentences.zh: 日距月最高倍度不及半周為加，過為減。

translations.literal: Double sun distance from moon apogee not reaching half circuit is add, exceeding is subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add if twice the solar elongation from lunar apogee is under 180°, subtract if over.

sentences.zh: 又求得對原角之邊，為本時兩心差。

translations.literal: Also obtain side opposite original angle, as present-time two-center difference.
translations.idiomatic: The side opposite the original angle gives the current eccentricity.

sentences.zh: 以最高實均加減用最高為最高實行，以最高實行減用平行為太陰引數，復用平三角形，以半徑千萬為一邊，本時兩心差為一邊，太陰引數與半周相減餘為所夾之角，求得對兩心差之角。

translations.literal: Apply apogee true mean add-subtract to use apogee as apogee true motion; use apogee true motion minus use mean as lunar anomaly; again plane triangle with radius ten million, present two-center difference, lunar anomaly minus half circuit as enclosed angle, obtain angle opposite two-center difference.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust mean apogee to true apogee, subtract from mean motion to get lunar anomaly, then a triangle with radius 10,000,000 and current eccentricity yields the angle opposite the eccentricity.

sentences.zh: 與原角相加，復為所夾之角。

translations.literal: Add to original angle, again as enclosed angle.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the original angle to form the new enclosed angle.

sentences.zh: 求得對半徑千萬之角，為平圓引數。

translations.literal: Obtain angle opposite radius ten million, as mean-circle anomaly.
translations.idiomatic: The angle opposite the radius gives the mean-circle anomaly.

sentences.zh: 乃以本天大半徑為一率，本時兩心差為正弦，對錶取餘弦為二率，平圓引數之正切線為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表為實引，與太陰引數相減為初均數。

translations.literal: Then major deferent semiaxis as first ratio, present two-center difference as sine, table cosine as second ratio, mean-circle anomaly tangent as third ratio, fourth ratio as tangent, table as true anomaly, subtract from lunar anomaly as first equation.
translations.idiomatic: A proportion with major semiaxis, cosine of eccentricity, and tangent of mean anomaly yields true anomaly; subtracting from lunar anomaly gives the first inequality.

sentences.zh: 置用平行，以初均數加減之，引數初宮至五宮為減，六宮至十一宮為加。

translations.literal: Set use mean motion, add-subtract first equation; anomaly first to fifth mansion subtract, sixth to eleventh add.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the first inequality to mean motion — subtract for mansions 1–5, add for mansions 6–11.

sentences.zh: 得初實行。

translations.literal: Obtain first true motion.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the first true motion.

sentences.zh: 求白道實行，置初實行，減本日太陽實行，為月距日。

translations.literal: Seek white-path true motion: set first true motion, subtract this day's sun true motion, as moon distance from sun.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar-path true motion: subtract the Sun's true longitude from the first true motion to obtain elongation.

sentences.zh: 乃以半徑千萬為一率，高卑最大二均數各為二率，月距日倍度正弦為三率，各求得四率，為本時高卑二均數。

translations.literal: Then radius ten million as first ratio, high-low maximum second equations each as second ratio, double moon-distance-from-sun sine as third ratio, each obtaining fourth ratio as present high-low second equations.
translations.idiomatic: Proportions with radius 10,000,000, the two maximum second inequalities, and sine of twice the elongation yield the two high-low second inequalities.

sentences.zh: 又以高卑立方大較為一率，本時立方較為二率，本時高卑二均數相減餘為三率，求得四率，與本時最高二均數相加，為本時二均數，記加減號。

translations.literal: Also high-low cube great comparison as first ratio, present cube comparison as second ratio, present high-low second equations subtracted remainder as third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio added to present apogee second equation as present second equation, record sign.
translations.idiomatic: A cube-ratio correction is added to the apogee second inequality to obtain the current second inequality, with sign recorded.

sentences.zh: 月距日倍度不及半周為加，過為減。

translations.literal: Double moon distance from sun not reaching half circuit is add, exceeding subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add if twice the elongation is under 180°, subtract if over.

sentences.zh: 又置月距日，加減二均，為實月距日。

translations.literal: Also set moon distance from sun, add-subtract second equation, as true moon distance from sun.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust elongation by the second inequality to obtain true elongation.

sentences.zh: 置太陽最卑平行，加減六宮，為日最高太陰最高實行。

translations.literal: Set sun perigee mean motion, add-subtract six mansions, as sun-apogee moon-apogee true motion.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust solar perigee mean motion by six mansions to obtain true solar and lunar apogee longitudes.

sentences.zh: 內減日最高，為日月最高相距。

translations.literal: Subtract within sun apogee, as sun-moon apogee separation.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract solar apogee to obtain separation of the two apogees.

sentences.zh: 與實月距日相加，為相距總數。

translations.literal: Add to true moon distance from sun, as total separation.
translations.idiomatic: Add true elongation to obtain the combined arc.

sentences.zh: 以半徑千萬為一率，最大三均為二率，相距總數正弦為三率，求得四率，為三均數，記加減號。

translations.literal: Radius ten million first ratio, maximum third equation second ratio, total separation sine third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as third equation, record sign.
translations.idiomatic: A proportion yields the third inequality, with sign recorded.

sentences.zh: 總數不及半周為加，過為減。

translations.literal: Total not reaching half circuit is add, exceeding subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add if the combined arc is under 180°, subtract if over.

sentences.zh: 又以半徑千萬為一率；

translations.literal: Also radius ten million as first ratio;
translations.idiomatic: Again with radius 10,000,000 as first ratio;

sentences.zh: 日月最高相距度用中比例，取本時兩弦最大末均為二率，實月距日正弦為三率，求得四率，為末均數，記加減號。

translations.literal: Sun-moon apogee separation degrees use mean proportion, taking present quadrature maximum final equation as second ratio, true moon-distance sine as third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as final equation, record sign.
translations.idiomatic: interpolate the maximum final inequality from apogee separation and sine of true elongation to obtain the final inequality, with sign recorded.

sentences.zh: 實月距日不及半周為減，過為加。

translations.literal: True moon distance from sun not reaching half circuit is subtract, exceeding add.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract if true elongation is under 180°, add if over.

sentences.zh: 乃置初實行，加減二均、三均、末均，得白道實行。

translations.literal: Then set first true motion, add-subtract second, third, final equations, obtain white-path true motion.
translations.idiomatic: Apply second, third, and final inequalities to first true motion to obtain lunar-path true longitude.

sentences.zh: 求黃道實行，用平三角形，以正交本輪半徑為一邊，正交均輪半徑為一邊，日距正交倍度為所夾之外角，倍度過半周，減去半周，用其餘。

translations.literal: Seek ecliptic true motion: plane triangle with true-node deferent radius, true-node epicycle radius, double sun distance from true node as exterior enclosed angle; if double exceeds half circuit, subtract half circuit and use remainder.
translations.idiomatic: For ecliptic true motion: a plane triangle with node deferent and epicycle radii and the supplement of twice the Sun's node elongation.

sentences.zh: 求得對兩邊二角之半較。

translations.literal: Obtain half-difference of two angles opposite the two sides.
translations.idiomatic: Half the difference of the two opposite angles is found.

sentences.zh: 與日距正交相減，餘為正交實均。

translations.literal: Subtract from sun distance from true node, remainder is true-node true mean.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the Sun's node elongation to obtain the true mean node correction.

sentences.zh: 以加減日距正交倍度不及半周為加，過為減。

translations.literal: Add-subtract: double sun distance from true node not reaching half circuit is add, exceeding subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add if twice the node elongation is under 180°, subtract if over.

sentences.zh: 用正交，為正交實行。

translations.literal: Apply true node, as true-node true motion.
translations.idiomatic: Apply to mean node to obtain true node longitude.

sentences.zh: 置白道實行，減正交實行，為月距正交。

translations.literal: Set white-path true motion, subtract true-node true motion, as moon distance from true node.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract true node from lunar-path true motion to obtain elongation from the node.

sentences.zh: 又以半徑千萬為一率，日距正交倍度正矢為二率，倍度過半周，與全周相減，用其餘。

translations.literal: Also radius ten million first ratio, double sun-node distance versed sine second ratio; if double exceeds half circuit, subtract from full circuit and use remainder.
translations.idiomatic: A proportion uses the versed sine of twice the solar node elongation, using the supplement if over 180°.

sentences.zh: 黃白大距半較為三率，求得四率，為交角減分。

translations.literal: Yellow-white great distance half-difference as third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as node-angle subtractive portion.
translations.idiomatic: Half the range of lunar latitude gives the node-angle reduction.

sentences.zh: 又以最大距日加分折半為三率，一率、二率同前。

translations.literal: Also maximum distance-from-sun added portion halved as third ratio; first and second ratios same as before.
translations.idiomatic: Half the maximum elongation increment is used as third ratio with the same first two ratios.

sentences.zh: 求得四率，為距交加差。

translations.literal: Obtain fourth ratio as distance-node combined difference.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the combined node-elongation correction.

sentences.zh: 又以半徑千萬為一率，實月距日倍度正矢為二率，倍度過半周，與全周相減，用其餘。

translations.literal: Also radius ten million first ratio, true moon-distance double versed sine second ratio; if double exceeds half circuit, subtract from full circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Another proportion uses the versed sine of twice true elongation, with supplement if needed.

sentences.zh: 距交加差折半為三率，求得四率，為距日加分。

translations.literal: Distance-node combined difference halved as third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as distance-from-sun added portion.
translations.idiomatic: Half the combined correction gives the elongation increment.

sentences.zh: 置最大大距，減交角，減分加距日加分，為黃白大距。

translations.literal: Set maximum great distance, subtract node angle reduction, subtractive portion add distance-from-sun added portion, as yellow-white great distance.
translations.idiomatic: From maximum latitude, subtract the reductions and add the increments to obtain the current lunar latitude.

sentences.zh: 乃以半徑千萬為一率，黃白大距餘弦為二率，月距正交、正切為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表為黃道距交度。

translations.literal: Then radius ten million as first ratio, yellow-white great distance cosine as second ratio, moon distance from true node tangent as third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as tangent, table lookup as ecliptic distance-from-node degrees.
translations.idiomatic: A proportion with radius 10,000,000, cosine of lunar latitude, and tangent of node elongation yields ecliptic longitude from the node.

sentences.zh: 與月距正交相減，餘為升度差。

translations.literal: Subtract from moon distance from true node, remainder is ascension-degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtracting node elongation gives the ascension correction.

sentences.zh: 以加減白道實行，月距正交初、一、二、六、七、八宮為減，三、四、五、九、十、十一宮為加。

translations.literal: Add-subtract to white-path true motion; moon distance from true node mansions 0,1,2,6,7,8 subtract, 3,4,5,9,10,11 add.
translations.idiomatic: Apply to lunar-path true motion — subtract for mansions 0–2 and 6–8, add for mansions 3–5 and 9–11.

sentences.zh: 得黃道實行。

translations.literal: Obtain ecliptic true motion.
translations.idiomatic: This yields true ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 求黃道緯度，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Seek ecliptic latitude, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: Ecliptic latitude is computed as in the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 求四種宿度，月孛用最高實行，羅㬋用正交實行加減六宮，計都用正交實行，餘同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Seek four kinds of lodging degrees: moon apogee uses apogee true motion, Rahu uses true-node true motion add-subtract six mansions, Ketu uses true-node true motion, remainder same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: Four lodging positions: lunar apogee uses true apogee longitude; Rahu adjusts true node by six mansions; Ketu uses true node; the rest follow the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 求紀日值宿。

translations.literal: Seek cycle-day lodging value.
translations.idiomatic: Determine which lodging each cycle-day falls in.

sentences.zh: 求交宮時刻。

translations.literal: Seek node-crossing mansion moments.
translations.idiomatic: Compute the times when the Moon crosses nodal mansions.

sentences.zh: 求太陰出入時刻。

translations.literal: Seek moon rise-set moments.
translations.idiomatic: Compute moonrise and moonset times.

sentences.zh: 求合朔弦望。

translations.literal: Seek conjunction, first-quarter, full moon, last-quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Compute new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter.

sentences.zh: 求正升、斜升、橫升。

translations.literal: Seek direct ascension, oblique ascension, horizontal ascension.
translations.idiomatic: Compute direct, oblique, and horizontal ascension.

sentences.zh: 求月大小。

translations.literal: Seek long and short months.
translations.idiomatic: Determine long and short months.

sentences.zh: 求閏月，並同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Seek intercalary month, all same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary months are determined as in the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 求月令，日躔娵訾，為建寅正月，東風解凍，蟄蟲始振，魚陟負冰，獺祭魚，候雁北，草木萌動，凡六候。

translations.literal: Seek monthly commands: sun in Juzi, as jianyin first month: east wind melts ice, hibernating insects stir, fish rise bearing ice, otters offer fish, wild geese northward, plants sprout — six pentads total.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly phenology: when the Sun is in Juzi (first month, jianyin): thawing winds, insects awakening, fish under ice, otters fishing, geese heading north, vegetation sprouting — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔降婁，為建卯二月，桃始華，倉庚鳴，鷹化為鳩，玄鳥至，雷乃發聲，始電，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Jianglou, as jianmao second month: peaches bloom, orioles sing, hawks become doves, swallows arrive, thunder sounds, lightning begins — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianglou (second month, jianmao): peach blossom, orioles singing, hawks molting, swallows returning, thunder and lightning — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔大梁，為建辰三月，桐始華，田鼠化為鴽，虹始見，萍始生，鳴鳩拂其羽，戴勝降於桑，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Daliang, as jianchen third month: paulownia blooms, field mice become quails, rainbows appear, duckweed sprouts, turtledoves preen, hoopoes descend on mulberry — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Daliang (third month, jianchen): paulownia flowering, mice to quails, rainbows, duckweed, doves preening, hoopoes on mulberry — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔實沈，為建巳四月，螻蟈鳴，蚯蚓出，王瓜生，苦菜秀，靡草死，麥秋至，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Shichen, as jiansi fourth month: frogs croak, earthworms emerge, gourds grow, bitter greens flourish, fragile grasses die, wheat ripens — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Shichen (fourth month, jiansi): frogs, earthworms, gourds, bitter greens, grasses dying, wheat harvest — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔鶉首，為建午五月，螳螂生，鵙始鳴，反舌無聲，鹿角解，蜩始鳴，半夏生，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Shou, as jianwu fifth month: mantises hatch, shrikes call, mockingbirds silent, deer antlers shed, cicadas chirp, pinellia grows — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Shou (fifth month, jianwu): mantises, shrikes, silent mockingbirds, deer shedding antlers, cicadas, pinellia — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔鶉火，為建未六月，溫風至，蟋蟀居壁，鷹始摯，腐草為螢，土潤溽暑，大雨時行，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Huo, as jianwei sixth month: warm winds arrive, crickets in walls, hawks strike prey, rotten grass becomes fireflies, earth damp with heat, great rains — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Huo (sixth month, jianwei): warm winds, crickets indoors, hunting hawks, fireflies, humid heat, heavy rains — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔鶉尾，為建申七月，涼風至，白露降，寒蟬鳴，鷹乃祭鳥，天地始肅，禾乃登，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Wei, as jianshen seventh month: cool winds, white dew falls, cold cicadas, hawks offer birds, heaven and earth grow austere, grain ripens — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Wei (seventh month, jianshen): cool winds, white dew, autumn cicadas, hawks hunting, autumn austerity, grain harvest — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔壽星，為建酉八月，鴻雁來，玄鳥歸，★鳥養羞，雷始收聲，蟄蟲坯戶，水始涸，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Shouxing, as jianyou eighth month: wild geese arrive, swallows depart, birds store food, thunder ceases, insects seal dens, waters recede — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Shouxing (eighth month, jianyou): geese arriving, swallows leaving, birds storing food, thunder ending, insects sealing burrows, waters drying — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔大火，為建戌九月，鴻雁來賓，雀入大水為蛤，菊有黃華，豺乃祭獸，草木黃落，蟄蟲咸俯，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Dahu, as jianxu ninth month: geese as guests, sparrows into great waters become clams, chrysanthemums yellow, jackals offer beasts, plants yellow and fall, insects all bow down — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Dahu (ninth month, jianxu): visiting geese, sparrows to clams, chrysanthemums, jackals hunting, foliage yellowing, insects hibernating — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔析木，為建亥十月，水始冰，地始凍，雉入大水為蜃，虹藏不見，天氣上升，地氣下降，閉塞而成冬，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Ximu, as jianhai tenth month: waters begin to freeze, earth freezes, pheasants into waters become clams, rainbows hidden, heaven qi rises, earth qi descends, blockage forms winter — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Ximu (tenth month, jianhai): freezing water and earth, pheasants vanishing, rainbows gone, qi ascending and descending, winter closing in — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔星紀，為建子十一月，鶡鴠不鳴，虎始交，荔挺出，蚯蚓結，麈角解，水泉動，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Xingji, as jianzi eleventh month: partridges silent, tigers mate, spring onions sprout, earthworms coil, elk antlers shed, springs stir — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingji (eleventh month, jianzi): silent birds, mating tigers, sprouting onions, coiled worms, shedding elk antlers, moving springs — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 日躔元枵，為建丑十二月，雁北鄉，鵲始巢，雉雊，雞乳，征鳥厲疾，水澤腹堅，凡六候。

translations.literal: Sun in Yuanxiao, as jianchou twelfth month: geese northward, magpies nest, pheasants crow, hens brood, migrant birds swift, waters firm at core — six pentads.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanxiao (twelfth month, jianchou): geese north, nesting magpies, crowing pheasants, brooding hens, swift migrants, frozen waters — six pentads.

sentences.zh: 每五度為一候，按宮度推之即得。

translations.literal: Every five degrees is one pentad; derive by mansion degrees and obtain.
translations.idiomatic: Each pentad spans 5°; assign by solar mansion longitude.

sentences.zh: 五星用數，推五星行，並同甲子元法，惟土星平行應減去三十分。

translations.literal: Five planets constants: derive five-planet motion all same as jiazi epoch method, only Saturn mean motion should subtract thirty minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Planetary constants and motion follow the jiazi epoch method, except Saturn's mean motion is reduced by 30′.

sentences.zh: 恆星用數，見天文志，推恆星法，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Fixed stars constants, see Astronomy Treatise; derive fixed stars method same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed-star constants are in the Astronomy Treatise; their computation follows the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 紫氣用數，乾隆九年甲子天正冬至為法元。

translations.literal: Purple Qi constants: Qianlong 9 jiazi first-month winter solstice as method epoch.
translations.idiomatic: Ziqi constants — epoch: winter solstice of Qianlong 9 jiazi.

sentences.zh: 癸亥年十一月冬至。

translations.literal: Guihai year, eleventh month, winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Winter solstice of the eleventh month, guihai year.

sentences.zh: 紫氣日行一百二十六秒，小餘七二０七七七。

translations.literal: Purple Qi daily motion 126 seconds, remainder 720777.
translations.idiomatic: Daily Ziqi motion: 126″, remainder 720777.

sentences.zh: 紫氣應七宮十七度五十分十四秒五十三微。

translations.literal: Purple Qi response seventh mansion seventeen degrees fifty minutes fourteen seconds fifty-three micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Ziqi epoch anomaly: 7th mansion 17°50′14.53″.

sentences.zh: 推紫氣法，求紫氣行，與日躔求平行法同。

translations.literal: Derive Purple Qi method: seek Purple Qi motion, same as solar-motion mean-motion method.
translations.idiomatic: Ziqi motion is computed by the same method as solar mean motion.

sentences.zh: 求宿度，與太陽同。

translations.literal: Seek lodging degrees, same as sun.
translations.idiomatic: Lodging degrees are computed as for the Sun.

sentences.zh: 求用平行，以太陽最大均數為一率，太陰最大一平均為二率，本日太陽均數化秒為三率，求得四率為秒。

translations.literal: Seek use mean motion: sun maximum equation as first ratio, moon maximum first mean as second ratio, this day sun equation converted to seconds as third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Working mean motion: a proportion from maximum solar equation, maximum first evection, and today's solar equation in seconds yields the first evection in seconds.

sentences.zh: 收為分，後皆同。

translations.literal: Collect as minutes; afterward all the same.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to minutes; subsequent steps follow the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 為太陰一平均。

translations.literal: This is moon first mean.
translations.idiomatic: This is the first evection.

sentences.zh: 又以最高最大平均為二率，一率、三率同前。

translations.literal: Also apogee maximum mean as second ratio; first and third ratios same as before.
translations.idiomatic: The same procedure with maximum mean apogee correction gives today's apogee evection.

sentences.zh: 求得四率為本日最高平均。

translations.literal: Obtain fourth ratio as this day apogee mean.
translations.idiomatic: This yields today's mean apogee correction.

sentences.zh: 又以正交最大平均為二率，求得四率，為本日正交平均，隨記其加減號。

translations.literal: Also true-node maximum mean as second ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as this day true-node mean, recording add-subtract sign.
translations.idiomatic: The same with maximum mean node correction, recording the sign.

sentences.zh: 太陰正交與太陽相反，最高與太陽同。

translations.literal: Moon true node opposite sun; apogee same as sun.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar node correction is opposite the solar sign; apogee correction matches the solar sign.

sentences.zh: 各加減平行，得太陰二平行及用最高用正交。

translations.literal: Each add-subtract to mean motion, obtaining moon two mean motions and use apogee use true node.
translations.idiomatic: Apply to mean motions to obtain the two lunar mean motions and working apogee and node longitudes.

sentences.zh: 於太陽實行內減去用最高，為日距月最高。

translations.literal: Within sun true motion subtract use apogee, as sun distance from moon apogee.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract working apogee from solar true longitude to obtain the Sun's elongation from lunar apogee.

sentences.zh: 減去用正交，為日距正交。

translations.literal: Subtract use true node, as sun distance from true node.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract working node to obtain the Sun's elongation from the node.

sentences.zh: 次以半徑千萬為一率，太陽引數內加減太陽均數為實引，取其餘弦為二率，太陽倍兩心差為三率，求得四率為分股。

translations.literal: Next radius ten million as first ratio, within sun anomaly add-subtract sun equation as true anomaly, take its cosine as second ratio, sun double two-center difference as third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as fractional leg.
translations.idiomatic: Next: with radius 10,000,000, true solar anomaly, its cosine, and twice the eccentricity, find the fractional leg.

sentences.zh: 又以實引正弦為二率，一率、三率同前。

translations.literal: Also true anomaly sine as second ratio; first and third ratios same as before.
translations.idiomatic: Using the sine of true anomaly with the same first and third ratios yields the other leg.

sentences.zh: 求得四率為勾；

translations.literal: Obtain fourth ratio as base leg;
translations.idiomatic: This yields the base leg.

sentences.zh: 以分股與全徑二千萬相加減，實引三宮內九宮外加，三宮外九宮內減。

translations.literal: Add-subtract fractional leg with full diameter twenty million; within three mansions of true anomaly add, outside three mansions subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the fractional leg from the full diameter of 20,000,000 — add within three mansions of true anomaly, subtract outside.

sentences.zh: 為股弦和；

translations.literal: as leg-hypotenuse sum;
translations.idiomatic: This forms the sum of the leg and hypotenuse.

sentences.zh: 求得弦。

translations.literal: obtain hypotenuse.
translations.idiomatic: From this the hypotenuse is found.

sentences.zh: 轉與全徑相減，為日距地心數。

translations.literal: Turn and subtract from full diameter, as sun distance-from-geocenter number.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from the full diameter to obtain the Sun's distance from Earth's center.

sentences.zh: 自乘再乘得立方積，與太陽最高立方積相減，為本時立方較。

translations.literal: Self-multiply and multiply again for cube product, subtract from sun apogee cube product, as present-time cube comparison.
translations.idiomatic: Cube the distance and subtract the solar apogee distance cubed to obtain the current cube ratio.

sentences.zh: 又以半徑千萬為一率，高卑最大二平均各為二率，日距月最高倍度正弦為三率，各求得四率，為本時高卑二平均。

translations.literal: Also radius ten million first ratio, high-low maximum second means each as second ratio, double sun-moon-apogee sine as third ratio, each obtaining fourth ratio as present high-low second means.
translations.idiomatic: Proportions yield the two high-low second evections for the current moment.

sentences.zh: 又以高卑立方大較為一率，本時立方較為二率，本時高卑二平均相減餘為三率，求得四率與本時最高二平均相加，為本時二平均，記加減號。

translations.literal: Also high-low cube great comparison first ratio, present cube comparison second ratio, present high-low second means subtracted remainder third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio added to present apogee second mean as present second mean, record sign.
translations.idiomatic: The cube-ratio correction is added to the apogee second inequality to obtain the current second inequality, with sign recorded.

sentences.zh: 日距月最高倍度不及半周為減，過為加。

translations.literal: Double sun-moon-apogee not reaching half circuit subtract, exceeding add.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract if twice the solar-lunar apogee arc is under 180°, add if over.

sentences.zh: 復以半徑千萬為一率，最大三平均為二率，日距正交倍度正弦為三率，求得四率，為三平均，記加減號。

translations.literal: Again radius ten million first ratio, maximum third mean second ratio, double sun-node sine third ratio, obtaining fourth ratio as third mean, record sign.
translations.idiomatic: Another proportion gives the third evection, with sign recorded.

sentences.zh: 日距正交倍度不及半周為減，過為加。

translations.literal: Double sun-node not reaching half circuit subtract, exceeding add.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract if twice the node elongation is under 180°, add if over.

sentences.zh: 乃置二平行，加減二三平均，得用平行。

translations.literal: Then set two mean motions, add-subtract second and third means, obtain use mean motion.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the second and third evections to the two mean motions to obtain the working mean motion.
